<td class="text"><p id="xdx_807_eus-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsDisclosureTextBlock_zcEiKUB0haA9" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

    <td style="width: 24px"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b>17.</b></span></td>
    <td style="text-align: justify"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_82D_zqA4VilqDKq2">Related Party Transactions</span></b></span></td></tr>
  </table>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>Key Management Compensation</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Key management personnel are persons responsible
for planning, directing and controlling activities of an entity, and include executive and non-executive persons. During the years ended
December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company recognized approximately $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensation_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--FinancialInstrumentAxis__custom--KeyManagementCompensationMember_zuWMCLWoK638" title="Stock-based compensation">2,762,000</span> and $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensation_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--FinancialInstrumentAxis__custom--KeyManagementCompensationMember_z1yymDaScPad" title="Stock-based compensation">1,301,213</span>, respectively, in compensation and stock-based
compensation, respectively, provided to key management.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>Related Party Balances</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">During the year ended December 31, 2025, the
Company had accrued approximately $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--AccruedLiabilitiesFairValueDisclosure_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember_zt9lzG1dKXOf" title="Accrued expenses">396,000</span> of expenses to a farming company that is owned by a member of management and shareholder, with approximately $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionAmountsOfTransaction_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember_zYzXjbHqKDJ2" title="Related party balance">390,000</span> unpaid as of period end. The farming company supplies cannabis biomass and raw input
materials to the Company for use in its extraction and manufacturing operations. This arrangement was entered into because the farming
company operates cultivation facilities capable of supplying the quality and volume of cannabis inputs required by the Company&#8217;s production
operations.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">In December 2025, Micah Anderson, a director and officer
of the Company, converted $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--AccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent_iI_c20251231__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--MicahAndersonMember_z4FQ61DI5fZe" title="Accrued liabilities">337,400</span> of accrued liabilities and interest and $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--NotesPayable_iI_pp2d_c20251231__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--MicahAndersonMember_zUg7PJysBmv5" title="Notes payable">644,679.93</span> of outstanding notes payable into <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--ConversionOfStockSharesIssued1_c20251201__20251231__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--MicahAndersonMember_z2XB6n1IPYhb" title="Conversion of shares">5,498,469</span> common
shares of the Company at a conversion price of CAD$<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1_iI_pid_uCADPShares_c20251231__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--MicahAndersonMember_za9rggljztI7" title="Conversion price">0.25</span> per share. The conversion was completed on the same terms as the Company&#8217;s broader
convertible debenture conversion transaction completed in December 2025. The terms of this conversion were established at the time the
notes payable were originally issued and were not modified in connection with Mr. Anderson&#8217;s conversion. This transaction was reviewed
and approved by the disinterested members of the Board of Directors.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company
entered into a note payable with a principal balance of $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--NonrelatedPartyMember_zoj388HOdY38" title="Principal balance">350,000</span> with annual interest of <span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_dp_c20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--NonrelatedPartyMember_zV4q3MWGe5Y5" title="Interest rate">0</span>% that matures January 6<sup>th</sup>, 2026.
This note was repaid in full on January 6<sup>th</sup>, 2026. The Company also entered into notes payable totaling $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--NotesPayable_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--NonrelatedPartyMember_zTm2plkVapNf">994,660</span>, including
cash received of $<span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--CashReceivable_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--NonrelatedPartyMember_zNh9p9lHsM8d" title="cash receivable">749,630</span> and the exchange of accrued liabilities and other related party payables totaling $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--AccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherLiabilities_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--NonrelatedPartyMember_zVksdIKjJha4" title="Accrued liabilities and other related party payables">245,050</span>, with annual interest
of <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_dp_c20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--NonrelatedPartyMember_zobuUKmZFaKk" title="Interest rate">0</span>% and no stated maturity. During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company made payments against these notes of $<span id="xdx_90F_ecustom--PaymentsOfNotesPayable_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--NonrelatedPartyMember_z5hBLHzkAsQ8" title="Payments against these notes">396,000</span>.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">During the year ended December 31, 2024, a note
payable with a principal balance of $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--NotesPayable_iI_c20241231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember_zKxd9K8yeRM1" title="Principal balance">400,000</span> and accrued interest of $<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--InterestReceivable_iI_c20241231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember_ztftKyw6XEs4" title="Accrued interest">72,000</span> were resold to a related party. The Company also borrowed
$<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--ShortTermBorrowings_iI_c20241231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__custom--RelatedPartyOneMember_za5wUNPQDVO7" title="Borrowed value">200,000</span> and $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--ShortTermBorrowings_iI_c20241231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__custom--RelatedPartyTwoMember_zhkX5vJjskv6" title="Borrowed value">39,000</span> from two additional related parties during the year ended December 31, 2024. During the year ended December 31,
2025, the Company also entered into a note payable with a principal balance of $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--NotesPayable_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember_zdV99Y7Mbubl" title="Principal balance">445,000</span> with annual interest of <span id="xdx_906_ecustom--AnnualInterest_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20251231_zQY8u08cQMW1" title="Annual interest">10</span>% that matures on April
6, 2026. The note is collateralized by the Company&#8217;s crypto currency. In the event the crypto currency is sold prior to the maturing
of the note, the collateral will shift to the SCRSB, LLC cultivation licenses and inventory to a value of 2.5 times the principal amount
of the note.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company
entered into a note payable with a principal balance of $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount_iI_c20241231_z1DPP8y1Gh7h" title="Principal balance">472,000</span> with annual interest of <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_dp_c20241231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember_zQGfg1s20UK4" title="Interest rate">25</span>% that matures on December 1, 2024. The note
was issued by Leef Holdings, Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, in favor of Anderson Development SJ, LLC, an entity controlled
by Micah Anderson, a director and officer of the Company. The note bears simple interest at a rate of <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage_iI_dp_c20241231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember_zg9mivRFOQN5" title="Interest rate">25</span>% per annum, with monthly payments
of principal and interest commencing April 1, 2024 and maturing on December 1, 2024. Prepayment is permitted at any time without penalty.
The note is secured by all membership interests in The Leaf At 73740, LLC, doing business as &#8220;The Leaf,&#8221; a licensed cannabis
dispensary located in Palm Desert, California (License No. C10-0000482-LIC), encumbered through a UCC-1 filing on certain personal property
located in Arizona. As of December 31, 2025, the outstanding balance of this note was $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount_iI_c20241231_zWJavfQIsBLa" title="Principal balance">472,000</span> with accrued interest of $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--InterestReceivable_iI_c20241231_zkRFLEZ1vxNg" title="Accrued interest">206,904</span>.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On November 2, 2021, the Company acquired <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20211102__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember_z8spDngRBrl3" title="Percentage of membership interest acquired">100</span>%
of the outstanding membership interests of Anderson Development SB, LLC (&#8220;ADSB&#8221;) from third parties and a controlling interest
holding related party in exchange for approximately $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiability_iI_c20211102__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_zRkkhTow6chd" title="Contingent consideration">1,440,000</span> plus up to an additional $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiability_iI_c20211102__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_zRChept538Ah" title="Contingent consideration">2,400,000</span> of consideration (the &#8220;Contingent
Consideration&#8221;) (collectively, the &#8220;Consideration&#8221;). The Consideration is payable in Common Stock. The Contingent Consideration
is subject to ADSB obtaining a land use permit and a business license by February 28, 2025 that permits ADSB to conduct cannabis cultivation
operations. ADSB primarily holds an option to acquire certain real property in Santa Barbara County, California. The Company determined
that the acquisition of ADSB membership interest was a common control transaction and have elected to record the assets acquired and
liabilities assumed at the historical book value rather than fair value with no recognition of goodwill or gain or loss.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Additionally, the Company elected to record
the equity consideration at par value and will recognize the Contingent Consideration in the consolidated financial statements only
when met. During the year ended December 31, 2022, Management determined it became highly probable ADSB would acquire the permit and
license within the allotted time. This was based on a large change and turnaround in the cultivation market during the year ended
December 31, 2022. As such, the Company has recorded an additional contingent consideration for the Earnout that will be paid out in
the form of equity and totaled $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityCurrent_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_zHrE4iX0dbUe" title="Contingent consideration, current">2,400,000</span>
and was reduced to $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityCurrent_iI_c20241231__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis__us-gaap--RelatedPartyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_z9KMhGgiuh9d" title="Contingent consideration, current">500,000</span>
as of December 31, 2024. During the year ended December 31, 2025, payments related to ADSB totaling $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--AssetAcquisitionContingentConsiderationLiability_iI_c20251231_zwGJssFME0bk" title="Totaling">160,000</span>
were made, leaving a balance of $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityCurrent_iI_c20251231_zLJPv2xADHD2">340,000</span>
outstanding as of December 31, 2025. See Note 15 &#8211; Contingent Consideration and Consideration Payable for further
information.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for related party transactions. Examples of related party transactions include transactions between (a) a parent company and its subsidiary; (b) subsidiaries of a common parent; (c) and entity and its principal owners; and (d) affiliates.</p></div>
